relationships.evidence: To efficiently measure the hallucination generated by LMMs, we propose GPT4-Assisted Visual Instruction Evaluation (GAVIE), a stable approach to evaluate visual instruction tuning like human experts. (ABSTRACT)

relationships.paper: Mitigating Hallucination in Large Multi-Modal Models via Robust Instruction Tuning
relationships.evidence: To improve the robustness and flexibility of the evaluation on visual instruction tuning, we propose GPT4-Assisted Visual Instruction Evaluation (GAVIE) to assess the LMM output in two different aspects: Relevancy to evaluate the instruction-following performance and Accuracy to measure the visual hallucination in the LMM output. (Section 1)

relationships.paper: Mitigating Hallucination in Large Multi-Modal Models via Robust Instruction Tuning
